demo.title: chit402-receipt-flow.sh
demo.code:
# 1) Read the 402 challenge (no payment yet)
curl -sS -D - -X POST https://api.chit402.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"xfuel/auto","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say hi in five words."}]}'
# Expect HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED (Base USDC, amount "10000" = $0.01)

# 2) Agent wallet signs CDP v2 PaymentPayload → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (Bankr does this)
# 3) Retry with payment header + API key; read verify_url from response:
#    x-xfuel-verify-url  OR  body.xfuel.verify_url

# 4) Offline verify (pinned issuer_jwk — no JWKS fetch required)
curl -sS "https://api.chit402.com/receipt/<task_id>?format=json" -o receipt.json
npx xfuel-verify receipt.json --json

setup: Set CHIT_API_URL=https://api.chit402.com (optional; this is the default)
Set CHIT_API_KEY to your partner key (demo: chit402-demo — rate-limited, unmetered /v1 only)
Set CHIT_MAX_USD_PER_CALL (e.g. 0.10) and CHIT_MAX_USD_SESSION (e.g. 1.00) before spending
Fund the Bankr agent wallet with Base USDC for x402 settlement
Install: install the chit402-receipt skill from https://github.com/XFuel-Lab/chit402/tree/main/skills/chit402-receipt
